title: SARA: SLO-Aware Resource Allocation for Disaggregated Agentic LLM Services
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) are driving the emergence of multi-modal and agentic services for mobile users through cloud and edge infrastructures, where long-context workloads pose daunting challenges for inference latency. Existing disaggregated LLM serving systems largely rely on hardware profiling, configuration enumeration, or heuristic scheduling, offering limited analytical guidance for cost-efficient resource allocation.
